{"basis":"measured","confidence":0.9,"fact_type":"defect","name":"MEASURED 2026-09-26 on 0.71.0: the merge driver's committed export names ITSELF as its parent (prev_content_hash == content_hash) and carries no taken_at; and fact:the-merge-driver-writes-the-merged-export-in-a-different-byte-layout-than-the-exporter-2026-09-22 recurs unchanged, including `wrote: unchanged` on a write that changed bytes","source":"reflow2-mcp 0.71.0 release binary as git merge driver; merges of main into reflow2 PR #595 and flo2 PR #80, 2026-09-26","statement":"OBSERVED twice in one session, merging main into two open PRs after their sibling records PRs had squash-merged (reflow2 #594 then #595; flo2 #79 then #80). Both repos have `.gitattributes` naming the reflow2 driver, configured as the 0.71.0 release binary.

(1) NEW DETAIL. The blob git committed for the merge (flo2 merge f355dbc) had content_hash 788a4e53 AND prev_content_hash 788a4e53, its own hash, and no taken_at key at all. The rebase of #595 onto main committed the same shape (no taken_at). A PR that commits the driver's result without a re-export therefore carries an export whose lineage points at itself and which cannot say what tree it was taken in. Whether the CI design gate refuses that was not tested: every merge here was followed by a re-export before pushing.

(2) RECURRENCE, same as 2026-09-22. `git diff --stat origin/main` read ~54k lines (flo2) and ~420k lines (reflow2) for a design delta of a few hundred. export_graph afterwards reported `wrote: unchanged` with the note "NOTHING WAS WRITTEN — the file already held exactly this design, byte for byte". That is false: `git status --porcelain` was EMPTY straight after the flo2 merge commit and showed ` M docs/design/flo2.json` straight after the export, the diff being prev_content_hash (788a4e53 → a949a287, the records PR's hash) and taken_at added. So `wrote` compares content only, while the note claims bytes.

Workaround used, and it holds: commit the merge, then export_graph (it anchors at the merge-base, which is now main's tip, so it chains one hop from main), then amend the still-unpushed merge commit, then push as a plain fast-forward. Exporting BEFORE committing the merge chains from the OLD merge-base (54c6c049 on reflow2, not #594's 12ba0f90), because HEAD has not moved yet. Not root-caused here.","steps":["export_graph"],"subject_id":"cap:merge-designs","valid_from":"2026-09-26"}
